Dallas Fort Worth’s Top Outdoor Living Specialist Dallas Texas’s Award Winning Pool Builder & Outdoor Living Company Welcome to Venture, where luxury design meets engineering mastery. Imagine your dream pool coming to life, exceeding your expectations. That’s the Venture Custom Pools difference. Picture yourself swimming in crystal-clear water, surrounded by your loved ones. Feel the warm sun on your skin and the cool water beneath your feet. Our seamless process makes building your pool a breeze. Our unparalleled craftsmanship ensures it will last for years to come. And the joy of owning a Venture Custom Pools creation is something you’ll treasure forever. Ready to turn your dream pool into reality? Call us today (972) 440-2408 ! Ryan J a year ago We hired Venture to build our pool. I have never had a pool before it is was a big project (pool, roof extension, detached patio, pavers, etc). We reviewed and met with several pool companies in DFW but when we had our first meeting with Andy we knew Venture was the company for us. I am not really that great with bringing a vision of what we want to life but my wife had a nice plan and Andy designed it and made it come to life. We could not be more pleased! When the construction started we were handed off to our project manager (Brett). It was easily the most pleasant experience of any of our home projects. Brett took care of everything quickly and all of the work is of the highest quality. When we had issues (all construction has issues) they were handled immediately and professionally. Cannot say enough praise for Brett - he is not just a good construction manager he is an ELITE construction manager. They did such a great job we have referred our neighbors and even my parents for different projects to Venture already. Venture exceeded expeditions and got our pool done in 3 months from start to first swim. And that’s with all the rain in DFW this year! If you want your pool to be amazing you need Venture Custom Pools! You absolutely get what you pay for and then some! kg013154 a year ago We got several pool estimates from large pool contractors in DFW and Venture pools allowed us to pick out much more customization than the other places, and at the best price. Ken Green was very responsive and helped us sign the contact. Once construction started, Bret our project manager had the pool installed in a matter of weeks, ahead of schedule, and with zero complications. Can’t say enough for this team. Thank you Venture for our great pool. Mark Birmes a year ago Yall are building a pool next to a customer of mine who has cinderblock atop the beam. When I saw yall dug with raised form boards it felt so good, gunite is better: Chris Furry a year ago From start to finish it was a great experience working with Venture Custom Pools! During the planning phase Greg was extremely helpful and accommodating with designing our pool to maximize the budget and space we had to work with. Greg even made several site visits to ensure we didn’t miss anything. Building a custom pool and home at the same time can be a stressful endeavor but the construction team (Angelica, Amanda, and Buddy) at Venture did an excellent job with scheduling to ensure our pool was finished at the same time as our house! Buddy, our project manager went above and beyond to facilitate a smooth project timeline, as well as answer all our questions during and after construction. Buddy even reached out several months after our pool was finished to make sure we were prepared for the freezing weather of December 2023! Two thumbs up for Venture Custom Pools. Jeung Ki Yoo a year ago I highly recommend considering Venture Custom Pool for your pool construction needs. I recently had my pool built by them, and the construction took place from October 2023 to February 2024. Mark Leuthold, the Senior Construction Consultant, did an exceptional job in meeting our requirements while staying within a reasonable budget. He presented an excellent initial design proposal based on our initial discussions and was very accommodating in making modifications to suit our preferences. The ability to view a virtual image of the proposed pool was incredibly convenient and allowed us to visualize the final outcome before any work began. Mark provided valuable suggestions and guidance based on his extensive knowledge and experience, which was immensely helpful throughout the process. Following the finalization of the design, we were introduced to Buddy Phillips, the Construction Manager, who efficiently organized the construction timeline. Buddy was proactive in keeping us informed of any delays or issues that arose during the construction phase. Whenever we had questions, Buddy promptly provided comprehensive answers, ensuring we remained fully informed throughout the project. Additionally, as we had to travel internationally during the construction period, Buddy was accommodating in rescheduling the construction activities to ensure we could observe crucial stages of the process. Even after the construction was finished, Buddy continued to offer strong support by addressing our inquiries and attending to post-construction requirements. He dedicated considerable time to thoroughly explain the operation instructions for the pool and promptly responded to any questions we had, spending hours ensuring we were fully informed. Overall, our experience with Venture Custom Pool, Mark, and Buddy exceeded our expectations, and we are thrilled with the final result of our pool. wali 2 years ago I’m a general contractor myself, and really wanted to build the pool myself, but I wanted to be 100% sure that it was going to be supervised from someone with years of dedication and experience specially with in-ground pools. I shopped around and meet several sales people. I wanted a quality built pool for a fair price but also and more importantly backed by a company with a strong backbone. I have heard several pool companies starting jobs and then shut down their doors. This is why I went with Venture Custom Pools. I had met with one of the senior sales guys name Mark a few years back when we first built our home. I remembered that he was patient communicative super experience in the field and genuinely wanted to just build pools for his clients family to enjoy. Trust me, he doesn’t need the sale. Their was no pushy tactics or unnecessary add-ons. Simply meeting the needs of what you want in your budget. Fast forward to July 2023, and we agreed on a design and a price that was reasonable. Like I said, I shopped around. Around 15 days later, we receive the approved permits from the city. There was a little hold up on our end with our HOA but we received the green light. We met our pool manager by the name of Buddy. Yes, that is his real name. He was super awesome. He stated that he doesn’t wanna make any promises but by the way things were looking and how he was setting up his schedule, he would have this project done, swim ready in five weeks. I was a little optimistic because I know the average time it takes with all the permit process, weather and other unforeseen delays. He kept us up to speed on everything that was taking place and shared so much knowledge, as he is very experienced in every aspect in the pool industry. Within four weeks, our pool was complete. Yes, four weeks and swimming. When you have a good manager that stays on top of his crew, back by a good company, this is the result. Our pool is beautiful. It’s even better than we thought it was going to be. Special shout out to my man Buddy! Keep up the good work. And thanks for giving us enough weekends to enjoy the pool before we entered the colder season. data.summary: The contractor has a significant and concerning discrepancy between platform ratings. The overwhelmingly positive Google reviews (4.7-5.0) conflict sharply with a poor Yelp rating (2.6). Without viewing the negative Yelp content, it's impossible to assess their validity, but such a large gap is a major red flag. The provided Google reviews lack the balanced critique typical of authentic feedback, raising suspicion they may not fully represent the customer experience.
fake_signals: Extreme rating disparity between platforms suggests potential review manipulation or suppression.
Google reviews provided are uniformly 5-star with generic, glowing praise and lack specific critical feedback, which is unusual for any service business.
Lack of access to negative review content prevents verification of authenticity signals.
authentic_signals: High volume of reviews on Angi (877) and Google (295+56) suggests a real, active customer base.
BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling (though specific complaint data is missing).
Some Google reviews mention specific names (Steven, Gregg) and project details.
complaint_patterns: Insufficient data from provided reviews to identify specific complaint patterns. The Yelp rating of 2.6 strongly implies unresolved customer issues.
